backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Reports feature-to-file mappings and components used for building the anniversary website.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup with custom OKLCH color variables and global theming for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the Book component and footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/book/Book.tsx: Manages page navigation and animations across the book-style multi-page layout.
frontend/src/components/book/pages/Closi: Final page with decorative icons, farewell messages, and a button returning to the cover.
frontend/src/components/book/pages/Cover: Book cover page showing title, VEERA’s name, an image, and an 'Open Our Story' button.
frontend/src/components/book/pages/Memor: Displays a grid of six themed memories with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/book/pages/Messa: Romantic letter-style page addressed to VEERA with decorative elements.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity and invalidates all non-actor queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and loading stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting that no backend queries are needed for the static site.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom themed variables for a warm book-like aesthetic along with utility classes like shadows and handwriting font.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, typography, and container settings matching the site's book aesthetic.
project_state.json: Stores metadata about the project state, features, and image requirements for the anniversary website.
